lines.en: Continuing the versioned Auric volumes: version seventeen turns sums and products into logarithms, triangles and squared amplitudes; version eighteen asks when a triangulation is a measurement, and when a phase inside a gate becomes a gate.
lines.zh: 延续 AURIC 版本系列：第十七版把加法与乘法化为对数、三角形与振幅平方；第十八版追问：三角剖分何时是一次测量，门里的相位何时自己成为一扇门。

lines.en: Auric versions seventeen and eighteen: quantum Pythagoras and recursive golden gates.
lines.zh: AURIC V17–V18：量子勾股与递归黄金门。

lines.en: One hidden ratio with a log and a phase, two triangulations, and a gate inside a gate.
lines.zh: 一个带着对数与相位的隐藏比值，两种三角剖分，以及门中之门。

lines.en: Start with sum and product. The logarithm is a semiring isomorphism: multiplication becomes addition, addition becomes log-sum-exp, so three, four, five reads two log five equals two log three, log-plus, two log four.
lines.zh: 先看加法与乘法。对数是半环同构：乘法变成加法，加法变成 log-sum-exp，于是 3、4、5 写成 2 log 5 = (2 log 3) ⊕ (2 log 4)。

lines.en: Squared length does the same for vectors, adding on direct sums and multiplying on tensor products; with unitary invariance, orthogonal additivity and unit weight one, the squared norm is the only such weight.
lines.zh: 向量的长度平方也是如此：在直和上相加，在张量积上相乘；若要求酉不变、对正交向量可加、单位向量权重为一，这样的权重只能是范数平方。

lines.en: Now the five modes, as corners of a pyramid, satisfy exactly one affine relation: v zero plus v thirteen equals v one plus v three. Of their ten triangles nine are right; left, middle, right is equilateral.
lines.zh: 再看五个模式：作为一座金字塔的顶点，它们恰有一条仿射关系 v₀ + v₁₃ = v₁ + v₃。十个三角形中九个是直角三角形；左、中、右构成等边三角形。

lines.en: Fixing the three occupation means leaves one segment along that relation, with hidden coupling kappa. Its coordinate is eta, the log of the four-corner ratio, which vanishes exactly when the ends are independent given an empty middle.
lines.zh: 固定三个占位均值，只剩沿这条关系的一条线段，参数是隐藏的联合量 κ。它的坐标是四角比的对数 η；η = 0 恰好表示中位为空时两端独立。

lines.en: On the segment, entropy has slope eta and is strictly concave, peaking at kappa star, X Y over R. Toward any target without hidden coupling, divergence is Pythagorean: one hidden correlation plus three visible readout mismatches.
lines.zh: 在线段上，熵的斜率是 η 且严格凹，在 κ* = XY/R 处取最大。对任何没有隐藏关联的目标，散度满足勾股分解：一项隐藏关联加三项可见读出失配。

lines.en: The quantum version adds a layer: quantum relative entropy to such a diagonal reference is record-basis coherence, plus hidden correlation, plus visible mismatch, all non-negative, so the maximum quantum entropy state is diagonal p star.
lines.zh: 量子版本多一层：相对这样的对角参考态，量子相对熵等于记录基相干，加上隐藏关联，再加上可见失配，三项都非负，所以最大量子熵态就是对角的 p*。

lines.en: Orthogonality needs a chosen geometry. Under p star, three readout directions and one interaction direction are orthonormal, so every variance is a sum of four squares; the hidden part alone gives Pearson's chi squared.
lines.zh: 正交性需要选定的几何。在 p* 下，三个读出方向与一个交互方向两两正交且归一，所以每个方差都是四个平方之和；仅隐藏部分就给出 Pearson χ²。

lines.en: Areas add as squares too: a covariance determinant is a weighted sum of squared simplex volumes. So two posterior means that both move while staying uncorrelated need three record outcomes, and three suffice, with area one eighth.
lines.zh: 面积也按平方相加：协方差行列式是单纯形体积平方的加权和。因此，两个后验均值都要变化且保持不相关，需要三个记录结果，而三个也足够，面积为 1/8。

lines.en: Now the core theorem. With complex amplitudes, the four-corner ratio Omega has log eta over two plus i Phi; with the middle empty, C squared is proportional to sinh squared of eta over four plus sine squared of Phi over two.
lines.zh: 现在是核心定理。取复振幅，四角比 Ω 的对数为 η/2 + iΦ；中位为空时，C² 正比于 sinh²(η/4) + sin²(Φ/2)。

lines.en: The ends are separable only when kappa is X Y over R and Phi is zero, and C squared plus Bloch length squared is one. Two states with all probabilities one fifth differ by one sign: product versus maximally entangled.
lines.zh: 所以两端可分，当且仅当 κ = XY/R 且 Φ = 0；并且 C² 加 Bloch 长度的平方等于一。两个概率全为 1/5 的态只差一个符号：一个是乘积态，一个最大纠缠。

lines.en: Fusion, tau times tau equals one plus tau, makes the weight phi, and one over phi squared plus one over phi is one: a golden right triangle. Projection gates with overlap lambda braid exactly when four lambda sine squared of half the phase is one.
lines.zh: τ 与 τ 融合为 1⊕τ，使重量为 φ，且 1/φ² + 1/φ = 1：一个黄金直角三角。重叠为 λ 的投影门，恰在 4λ sin²(θ/2) = 1 时满足编织关系。

lines.en: So lambda is at least one quarter. At the golden overlap the phase is e to the three pi i over five, keeping a state with weight one over phi squared. The gate returns at power ten; recorded each step, it relaxes to uniform.
lines.zh: 所以 λ ≥ 1/4。在黄金重叠处，相位为 e^(±3πi/5)，基态以权重 1/φ² 保持。门的第十次幂回到恒等；若每一步都记录，概率则趋于均匀。

lines.en: Version eighteen returns to the segment: diagonal zero to thirteen completes to the upper endpoint, the other to the lower. The rule is not affine, so no fixed channel performs it; channels keeping all three readouts only change phases.
lines.zh: 第十八版回到这条线段：对角线 0–13 完成到上端点，另一条完成到下端点。这个规则不是仿射的，所以没有固定通道能执行它；保持三个读出的通道只能改变相位。

lines.en: An instrument can. Calibrated to a known source, two diagonal Kraus operators return the two endpoints, each keeping the three means; on the balanced base, one fixed even-odd measurement realises both triangulations, with probability two kappa.
lines.zh: 仪器可以。按已知来源标定，两个对角 Kraus 算子给出两个端点，各自保持三个均值；在平衡底面上，一次固定的偶奇测量实现两种剖分，概率为 2κ。

lines.en: Inside a gate, giving each edge of a kernel its own unitary keeps columns normalised, but an isometry also needs a cross-column condition. A golden block still squares to the identity with a unitary W off the diagonal.
lines.zh: 在门的内部，给核的每条边配一个酉算符，可以保持各列归一，但等距还需要跨列条件。黄金块在非对角位置放入酉算符 W 后，平方仍是恒等。

lines.en: A phase lifts two ways: controlled, W only on P, or whole, W off P and W squared on P. Only the controlled lift composes for every pair, and a global phase of W becomes a visible relative phase.
lines.zh: 相位有两种提升：受控提升，只在 P 上作用 W；整门提升，P 外为 W、P 上为 W²。只有受控提升对任意一对门都可复合；W 的整体相位会变成可见的相对相位。

lines.en: Which inner gates keep the braid? With a shared operator W, it holds exactly when W minus I times W plus lambda W minus I squared vanishes, so at the golden overlap every eigenvalue is one, zeta or zeta bar.
lines.zh: 哪些内部门保持编织？共用同一个算符 W 时，编织恰在 (W − I)[W + λ(W − I)²] = 0 时成立，所以在黄金重叠下，每个本征值都是 1、ζ 或其共轭 ζ*。

lines.en: So the whole golden gate cannot be substituted into itself: its eigenvalue zeta squared is not allowed, though the lift stays unitary. The controlled recursion closes: W n is I plus zeta minus one times all control projections.
lines.zh: 所以整个黄金门不能代入自身：它的本征值 ζ² 不被允许，尽管该提升仍是酉的。受控递归则闭合：Wₙ = I + (ζ − 1)Eₙ，Eₙ 是全部控制投影的乘积。

lines.en: When does an inner gate become a record? Tracing it out multiplies the parent's coherence by m, the trace of sigma W, and full decoherence is possible exactly when zero lies in the convex hull of the spectrum.
lines.zh: 内部门何时变成记录？对它取偏迹，会把父系统的相干乘以 m = Tr(σW)；完全去相干可能实现，当且仅当零位于谱的凸包之中。

lines.en: No two of one, zeta and zeta bar are opposite, so a golden record needs all three, with unique weights one over phi cubed and one over phi squared twice; one coupling records only for lambda from one quarter to one half.
lines.zh: 1、ζ、ζ* 中任意两个都不对径，所以黄金记录需要全部三个，唯一的权重为 1/φ³、1/φ²、1/φ²；一次耦合只在 1/4 ≤ λ ≤ 1/2 时能形成记录。

lines.en: Does the recursion settle? With fresh records coherence shrinks by the product of overlaps, vanishing exactly when the sum of minus log moduli diverges; reusing one record gives overlap zeta to the n plus zeta to the two n, over two.
lines.zh: 递归会定格吗？每次用新记录，相干按各次重叠之积缩小，当且仅当 −log|mⱼ| 之和发散时消失；若复用同一个记录，重叠为 (ζⁿ + ζ²ⁿ)/2。

lines.en: At the fifth use it is zero, pointers orthogonal; at the tenth it is one, the coupling back to the identity. The gates never converge in norm, each step moves by phi, yet a fixed observer's prediction settles.
lines.zh: 第五次时它为零，指针正交；第十次时它为一，耦合回到恒等。这些门在范数下不收敛，每一步都移动 φ，但固定观察者的预测会定格。

lines.en: Logarithms turn products into sums, five modes leave one hidden ratio, divergence and entanglement split into squares, fusion gives a golden triangle, instruments turn triangulations into measurements, and inner gates braid on three phases.
lines.zh: 对数把乘积变成和，五个模式留下一个隐藏比值，散度与纠缠分解为平方之和，融合给出黄金三角，仪器把三角剖分变成测量，内部门只在三个相位上编织。

lines.en: Information projection, Cauchy-Binet, concurrence, Fibonacci fusion and quantum instruments are published or classical inputs, the rest is argued in the theory volumes, and the finite computations were redone for this film.
lines.zh: 信息投影、Cauchy–Binet、concurrence、Fibonacci 融合与量子仪器是已发表或经典的输入，其余结论在理论卷中论证，有限计算都为本片重新做过。
